name: §xACE MC | BEST SMP
description:
🌟 Welcome to our BRAND NEW 1.20 Survival Server! BEDROCK COMPATIBLE! It's just been released, and we couldn't be more excited to have you join us on this incredible journey!

IP: mp.acemc.co

Bedrock Port: 19132

🎉 Join our Discord community at discord.acemc.org and become a part of the Ace MC family. We're not just a server; we're a place where you can make new friends, create your very own warps, find your dream job, build your wealth, unwind, and simply have a blast! We'd love for you to be one of our original pioneers and experience the magic from the very beginning.

🌍 If you're in search of the perfect place to enjoy pure survival gameplay, connect with like-minded individuals, and have an amazing time, look no further! Our server boasts a warm and welcoming community, a robust land-claim system to protect your creations, custom fishing and farming experiences that'll have you hooked, as well as an array of engaging quests and ranks. It's everything you need for a fantastic adventure!

Come on in, and let's make unforgettable memories together! 🌟
